newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 29.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Actress Pai Ping-ping's daughter, Pai Hsiao-yen, found dead.
Police start all-out search for Pai Hsiao-yen's kidnappers and killer.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Pai Hsiao-yen dies.
President Lee Teng-hui and Premier Lien Chan vow to improve social order.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui tells authorities to arrest kidnappers as soon as possible.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Council for Economic Planning and Development plans to adjust methods to measure leading business indicators.
More state-owned banks set up overseas branches.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan mulls setting limits for mainland investment.
